description: This source file contains unit tests for the 'Module' class in the OpenMRS project, covering methods related to error handling, module dependencies, and advice point disposal.

classes.name: ModuleTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the Module class in the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Initializes the test module before each test.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldThrowExceptionWhenMessageIsNull
methods.description: Tests that setting a null startup error message throws a ModuleException.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldThrowExceptionWhenThrowableIsNull
methods.description: Tests that setting a null throwable for the startup error message throws a ModuleException.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldsetStartupErrorMessageWhenExceptionMessageIsNull
methods.description: Verifies that setting a startup error message with a null message correctly sets the message with the exception's message.

methods.name: setStartupErrorMessage_shouldAppendTheThrowablesMessageToExceptionMessage
methods.description: Ensures that the error message appends the throwable's message when setting the startup error message.

methods.name: setRequiredModules_shouldSetModulesWhenThereIsANullRequiredModulesMap
methods.description: Tests setting required modules when the existing map is null.

methods.name: getRequiredModuleVersion_shouldReturnNullIfNoRequiredModulesExist
methods.description: Checks that retrieving required module version returns null if no modules are set.

methods.name: getRequiredModuleVersion_shouldReturnNullIfNoRequiredModuleByGivenNameExists
methods.description: Checks that the version for a non-existent module returns null.

methods.name: addRequiredModule_shouldAddModuleToRequiredModulesMap
methods.description: Verifies adding a required module and retrieving its version.

methods.name: disposeAdvicePointsClassInstance_shouldDisposeAllClassInstancesNotAdvicePoints
methods.description: Tests disposal of class instances in advice points, ensuring proper cleanup.
